name: Gunner Fast 8
positioningNotes: Jinx in the corner farthest from enemy assassins, Aphelios on the opposite corner so one flank always survives. Full tank wall front-center.
levelingGuide: Standard fast 8: level 5 at 2-5, level 6 at 3-2, level 7 at 4-1, push level 8 at 4-5.
economyGuide: Greed to 50 gold by stage 3 and hold interest. Only break streaks if you would bleed below 60 HP.
rollTiming: Roll down to ~20 gold at level 8 (4-5) for Jinx and Aphelios 2-star, then slow-roll above 50.
whenToPlay: Play this when you hit an early econ augment or a win-streak stage 2 board. Gunner opener with Ziggs and Tristana makes the transition free.
strengths: Strongest level 8 power spike in the meta
weaknesses: Weak mid game if you bleed HP before level 8

name: Vayne Duelist Reroll
positioningNotes: Vayne one hex off the corner so enemy snipers reach the tank line first. Yasuo second row on the same side to clean up divers.
levelingGuide: Stay level 6 through stage 3 while slow-rolling. Push 7 at 4-2 once Vayne and Garen hit 3 stars.
economyGuide: Slow-roll above 50 gold from 3-1. Never dip below 50 until your carries are 3-starred.
rollTiming: Roll every round at level 6, only the gold above 50.
whenToPlay: Take this line with an early 2-star Vayne, Duelist augments, or when nobody else is on 1-cost reroll.
strengths: Very stable mid game — rarely bleeds
Cheap to hit; forgiving for newer players
3-star Vayne shreds tank-heavy lobbies with true damage
weaknesses: Hard caps in power at 3-star carries
Falls off against multiple 2-star legendary boards
Griefed badly if Vaynes are contested

name: Vertical Sorcerers
positioningNotes: Ahri center-back to line her orb through the enemy front line. Katarina second row center. Wrap tanks around her against assassins.
levelingGuide: Level 6 at 3-2, level 7 at 4-1, level 8 at 5-1 after stabilizing with Lux items.
economyGuide: Standard interest play; Lux perfectly holds every Ahri item so never slam off-comp.
rollTiming: Small roll at 7 for Katarina 2-star, main roll-down at 8 for Ahri.
whenToPlay: Go Sorcerers with an early rod opener, Jeweled Lotus, or a 2-star Lux by stage 3.
strengths: Huge AoE burst turns fights instantly
Perfect item transfer from Lux to Ahri
weaknesses: Struggles into stacked magic resist and Mystic boards
One-carry damage profile — Ahri dies, fight ends

name: Mystic Vanguard Fortress
positioningNotes: Full front wall of Vanguards. Kayle in the corner — she needs the longest possible ramp time behind the fortress.
levelingGuide: Slow, defensive levels: 7 at 4-2, 8 at 5-2. This comp stabilizes on defense, not tempo.
economyGuide: Loss-streak stage 2 into massive interest is acceptable — the late board outlasts everyone.
rollTiming: Roll at 8 for Leona and Kayle. Kayle 2-star is your win condition.
whenToPlay: Pick this with heavy tank items early, Mystic augments, or an AP-hostile lobby you want to outlast.
strengths: Excellent against burst and AP lobbies
Simple positioning that rarely needs scouting
weaknesses: Weak to healing reduction on the front line

name: Blademaster Flex
positioningNotes: Kayle corner with the full team shielding her diagonal. Yasuo and Katarina flank opposite sides to split enemy backline attention.
levelingGuide: Flexible: match lobby tempo, usually 7 at 4-1 and 9 if the game goes late — Kayle at 9 is the payoff.
economyGuide: Play tight interest and preserve HP; this line needs level 9 gold to cap.
rollTiming: Minimal rolling until 9, then dump everything for Kayle and Sett 2-star.
whenToPlay: Only with a Kayle hit before 4-5 plus uncontested Blademasters. A specialist line for experienced players.
strengths: Highest cap in the game with 2-star Kayle at 9
Hard to itemize against — mixed damage profile
Uses leftover comps' units, so rarely contested
weaknesses: Requires precise econ and HP management
Useless if you never see Kayle
